_comment: Cited waivers for the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 reference design's PER-SHEET rule runs. Each entry is scoped to one sheet's Design name; the merged-board pass needs none of them. Run: python -m src.ecad.rules check examples.esp32_s3_reference --waivers examples/esp32_s3_reference/rule_waivers.json

waivers.reason: VBUS is driven by the USB-C receptacle J1 on the usb sheet
waivers.cited_source: examples/esp32_s3_reference/design.py, 'Cross-sheet net convention': +3V3, GND and VBUS are KiCad global power symbols, which are global across a hierarchy — the rail is driven on another sheet of the same project. The merged-board pass (RuleContext.merged) reports it clean.
waivers.author: stage-g

waivers.reason: +3V3 is driven by the AP2112K-3.3 on the power sheet
waivers.cited_source: examples/esp32_s3_reference/design.py, 'Cross-sheet net convention': +3V3, GND and VBUS are KiCad global power symbols, which are global across a hierarchy — the rail is driven on another sheet of the same project. The merged-board pass (RuleContext.merged) reports it clean.
waivers.author: stage-g

waivers.reason: the 10 uF at the power entrance is C1, the LDO input capacitor on the power sheet; VBUS is one net across both sheets
waivers.cited_source: examples/esp32_s3_reference/design.py, 'Cross-sheet net convention': +3V3, GND and VBUS are KiCad global power symbols, which are global across a hierarchy — the rail is driven on another sheet of the same project. The merged-board pass (RuleContext.merged) reports it clean. Corroborated by the design's own note: 'HDG Power Supply: at least 10 uF at the main power entrance. The 10 uF is fitted (C1, the LDO input capacitor).'
waivers.author: stage-g
